source.note: Collected from https://www.thapar.edu/faculties and the official department and school faculty pages it links to. Values are as officially published; nothing is invented. Entries listed under several units are merged by institutional email (the department entry is primary; the others are kept in alsoListed). unitOrder and listingOrder keep the official page order.

rules: Treated as verified official data (owner instruction 2026-10-25).
Missing values stay null: no email, specialization or photo is guessed.
Photos are imported only from official thapar.edu URLs, through the quarantine-first upload pipeline.
